prompt: We publish Contoso Notes as an MSIX at https://downloads.contoso.com/notes/ (the current build is dist\Contoso.Notes_1.2.0.0_x64.msix, and that's the file name it has on the server). Right now people have to download each new version by hand. I want installed copies to check for a newer version every time the app is launched and update themselves. Please create the file we need to publish next to the MSIX and put it in dist\.
checks: appinstaller-exists (required): an .appinstaller file exists under the folder
appinstaller-xml (required): it is an <AppInstaller> document in an App Installer schema namespace
appinstaller-self-uri (required): its Uri is an .appinstaller URL under https://downloads.contoso.com/notes/
appinstaller-version (required): it has a four-part Version
appinstaller-main-package (required): MainPackage Name, Publisher, Version, and architecture match the MSIX
appinstaller-every-launch (required): OnLaunch has HoursBetweenUpdateChecks="0" (the default is 24 hours)
